The 30 September digest gives ticket #8841. It says Mateo Quiroga submitted it for Vantorre Group (VTG), because drivers at the Newark facility couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk for the second shift. It also says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check the number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July in #strategic-pod you wrote that you'd closed #8841 with support, and that one was about the Detention Summary CSV export and kiosk browser cache. The same number appearing for two different issues could be a typo in the digest or a reused number. I can't see the ticketing system, so I can't tell which.

The only other VTG ticket I found is INC-4821. That's the Hartford status-page access issue from 3 August, so it isn't the Door 14 ticket.

I'd confirm #8841 against the support queue, or ask Mateo, before you cite it.
